actionable_steps.citation: Namasmarana is the Greatest Sadhana in the Kali Yuga — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-07-12
actionable_steps.step: When anger rises, leave the place at once, drink a cup of cold water, and sing the Divine Name until it subsides.

actionable_steps.citation: The power of faith — SSS Vol 27 (1994)
actionable_steps.step: Refuse to talk or act while in an angry mood — silence first, decisions later.

actionable_steps.citation: Rise From Animality To Divinity — SSS Vol 25 (1992), 1992-05-24
actionable_steps.step: When anger, hatred or pride stir in you, sit silently for a few minutes instead of giving vent to them.
Avoid rajasic foods that promote anger; keep your diet simple and sathwic.

actionable_steps.citation: The quest for truth — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-04-14
actionable_steps.step: Meet anger with the shield of inner peace and meet hatred with your innate love — you are bound to win.

definition.quote: Anger is the worst exhibition of the ego. When you run after temporary pleasure any disappointment or obstacle will produce anger and hatred. The angry man is blind and temporarily mad.

discourses.citation: Realise the Oneness of the Atmic Principle — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-28
discourses.quote: One bout of anger drains away the energy gained in three months; it pollutes and heats the blood, which takes three months to regain normal state. Anger makes a person physically and mentally weak. Therefore, give no scope to anger.

discourses.citation: I And You Are One — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-07-05
discourses.quote: When you are angry, sit quietly in one place and drink cold water. Chant the Divine Name. Then your anger will gradually subside.
Krodha (anger) is deadly poison. It affects others by its fumes, manifested through the eye, the tongue and the hands.

discourses.citation: Why I love villages most — SSS Vol 13 (1975 - 77), 1975-04-28
discourses.quote: Conquer anger by means of fortitude; conquer hatred by love. Do not feed anger with retaliation; do not feed hatred with fury.

make_it_real: The next time anger knocks, put a glass of cold water between you and your words.
title: Anger

vahinis.quote: It will remain unruffled by lust, greed, anger, and conceit; it will be free from delusion. It will always seek the welfare of the world. From such a mind will flow an uninterrupted stream of love.
